Label: gene
Description: A region of DNA that encodes a functional product; used here for the small number of NeST members represented as genes rather than proteins.

Label: protein
Description: A protein is an organic polymer composed of one or more linear polymers of amino acids; NeST members and IAS network nodes are UniProt proteins.

Label: Statement
Description: The class of RDF statements, used to reify protein-protein interaction edges so that IAS scores can be attached to them.

Label: Class
Description: The class of RDF classes; present because nestkg ships its own schema declarations alongside the data.

Label: Class
Description: The class of OWL classes; present because nestkg ships its own schema declarations alongside the data.

Label: Activity
Description: Something that occurs over a period of time and acts upon entities; here the nest_to_rdf conversion run that generated the graph.

Label: Entity
Description: A physical, digital or conceptual thing with provenance; here the NeST dataset and the NDEx networks it was derived from.

Label: Association
Description: A reified statement linking a NeST protein system to a cancer type, carrying the evidence, knowledge level, and mutation frequency for that system-disease pair.

Label: protein system
Description: A set of proteins identified as functioning together, derived by multiscale community detection over a protein-association network. Spans scales from protein complexes to broad cellular processes.

Label: created
Description: Date of creation of the resource.

Label: description
Description: An account of the resource.

Label: identifier
Description: An unambiguous reference to the resource; NeST systems carry a NEST:n accession.

Label: publisher
Description: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

Label: source
Description: A related resource from which the described resource is derived; the NeST publication.

Label: title
Description: A name given to the resource.

Label: object
Description: The object of a reified RDF statement; the second protein of an IAS interaction.

Label: predicate
Description: The predicate of a reified RDF statement.

Label: subject
Description: The subject of a reified RDF statement; the first protein of an IAS interaction.

Label: comment
Description: A human-readable description of the subject resource.

Label: domain
Description: States that any resource with the given property is an instance of the stated class.

Label: label
Description: A human-readable name for the subject resource; for a protein system this is its NeST system name, such as "mRNA processing".

Label: range
Description: States that the values of the given property are instances of the stated class or datatype.

Label: see also
Description: Indicates a resource that may provide additional information about the subject resource.

Label: subclass of
Description: States that all instances of one class are instances of another.

Label: subproperty of
Description: States that all resources related by one property are also related by another.

Label: was associated with
Description: Assigns responsibility for an activity to an agent; the nest_to_rdf conversion code.

Label: was derived from
Description: Links the graph to the source NDEx networks it was built from.

Label: was generated by
Description: Links the dataset to the activity that produced it.

Label: agent type
Description: The type of agent that produced the association; every NeST association is asserted by a data analysis pipeline.

Label: has evidence
Description: Links an association to an ECO evidence term describing how it was established.

Label: has member
Description: Links a NeST protein system to a member protein. Membership is suppressed for systems above the size cutoff, so member counts may exceed the number of these triples.

Label: interacts with
Description: An undirected protein-protein association from the Integrated Association Stringency (IAS) network; reified so each edge carries its IAS score.

Label: knowledge level
Description: The epistemic status of the association; NeST associations are statistical associations.

Label: object
Description: The object of a biolink association; a MONDO cancer type.

Label: part of
Description: Places a NeST protein system within the containing system in the NeST hierarchy, up to the NEST root.

Label: predicate
Description: The relation asserted by a biolink association; NeST uses genetically associated with.

Label: subject
Description: The subject of a biolink association; a NeST protein system.

Label: integrated association stringency
Description: The IAS score: a granularity/stringency measure of shared-system membership, trained to predict GO semantic similarity. NOT a probability, p-value, or binding score.

Label: retained for connectivity
Description: True on an edge kept only because it is one of its proteins' single highest-scoring edge, i.e. below the IAS core threshold. Emitted only where true.

Label: member count
Description: Number of distinct member proteins in the system as reported by the source. NOT necessarily the number of emitted biolink:has_member triples: membership is suppressed above the size cutoff, and a few members have no node in the interaction network.

Label: HiSig adjusted p-value
Description: Benjamini-Hochberg-corrected empirical p-value from HiSig's permutation test, pan-cancer. One value per system, emitted for all systems; many are exactly 1.0, i.e. not significant.

Label: HiSig weight
Description: Lasso coefficient assigned to the system by HiSig - how much of the observed mutational signal the model attributes to it. One value per system, from the pan-cancer run. NOT a significance measure: read it together with nestv:hisigAdjustedPValue, emitted on the same node for every system.

Label: tumors mutated fraction
Description: Fraction of tumors in the cohort carrying at least one somatic mutation in any member gene of the system. Numerator: patients with >=1 mutated member. Denominator: patients in the cohort.
